channel.title: Markets & Finance | Global Business News Today
channel.description: Central bank decisions, interest rates, inflation and financial market analysis.

item.title: UK CMA Flags Competition Concerns Over AkzoNobel's $25 Billion Axalta Merger
item.description: The UK CMA says AkzoNobel's merger with Axalta could hurt competition in vehicle refinish paint, threatening a Phase 2 probe unless remedies are offered.

item.title: Anthropic Floats a $69.3 Billion IPO at $70 to $80 a Share, Then Calls the Pricing Inaccurate
item.description: Anthropic sent bankers IPO terms of $70-$80 a share, up to $69.3 billion, then called them inaccurate. What the SEC filing shows and what comes next.

item.title: Trump Media Investors Have Lost $2.2 Billion as DJT Hits Record Low, Reuters Finds
item.description: Trump Media's outside investors have lost over $2.2 billion, Reuters estimates, as DJT closed at a record $4.02. Trump's stake, revenue and what's next.

item.title: Moderna Raises 2026 Outlook to 15% to 25% Growth After Q3 Revenue Jumps 29%
item.description: Moderna's Q3 2026 revenue rose 29% to $1.3 billion and it raised 2026 growth guidance to 15%-25%. Key numbers, pipeline updates and what comes next.

item.title: Airbnb Q3 2026 Earnings: Revenue Up 19%, Outlook Raised and $12 Billion Buyback
item.description: Airbnb grew Q3 2026 revenue 19% to $4.9 billion, raised its full-year outlook and approved a $12 billion buyback. Here is what drove it and what is next.

item.title: Global Stocks Slide as AI Sell-Off Spreads: Nikkei Hits Bear Market, FTSE Falls 2%
item.description: Wall Street's AI rout spread to Asia and Europe on Nov 6. The Nikkei and Kospi fell about 6%, the FTSE 100 dropped over 2% and sterling slipped.

item.title: Nasdaq Rebounds After Its Worst Day Since April 2025 as Jobs Report Beats
item.description: Chip stocks bounced on November 6 after a midterm-driven AI rout pushed the Nasdaq into correction. Payrolls rose 165,000, raising Fed hike bets.

item.title: Asian Shares Mixed as Kospi Sinks 4% on Chip Sell-Off, Oil Rebounds After US Strikes on Iran
item.description: Asian shares were mixed Tuesday as South Korea's Kospi fell 4% on a tech sell-off, oil rose 2% after US strikes on Iran and Australia raised rates to 4.85%.

item.title: Apple and Palantir Stock Fall Despite Earnings Beats
item.description: Apple and Palantir stock fell in premarket trading after both beat estimates. Apple's margin outlook and memory costs are weighing on its shares.

item.title: Binance Hack: Exchange Says 95% of $6.3 Billion Theft Now Covered as Withdrawals Resume
item.description: Binance says it has replaced about 95% of the crypto stolen in a record $6.3 billion hack the FBI blames on North Korea, as $3.6 billion left the exchange.

item.title: Anthropic IPO Filing: Revenue Hits $33.2 Billion in Nine Months as Net Loss Reaches $104 Billion
item.description: Anthropic's amended IPO filing shows Q3 revenue of $17 billion and a $104 billion nine-month net loss, mostly a non-cash charge tied to its rising valuation.

item.title: Fed Holds at 3.75% to 4%, Signals More Hikes: What Higher Rates Mean for SMEs
item.description: The Fed held rates at 3.75% to 4% after a September hike, and the ECB and BoE lean hawkish as energy lifts inflation. What it means for SME borrowing.
